author: mohamedgddg
quote: I expected the game to be at least on par with GTA V in terms of fun and humor; instead, they’ve given us a "dating simulator" rather than a GTA game. I knew it would be absolute garbage the moment I found out the protagonist was a woman. I don’t know why they did this—it’s the stupidest decision I’ve ever seen. Why have a female lead in a game entirely centered around crime, theft, and everything illicit? They claim to care about realism—well, where’s the realism in that? I’ve played every GTA installment from 3 to 5, and all of them are better than this piece of trash. I suppose we should have realized this company isn't what it used to be, ever since they released the "remastered" GTA trilogy. Honestly, Rockstar should never have allowed a game this bad to be released. They kept hyping it up, claiming GTA VI would "blow us away." The only decent things in this game are the graphics and the NPCs; otherwise, it’s total garbage. I really hoped it would at least be on the same level as GTA V.
